name: settings-heading-scale
description: Settings headings all come from the shared surface recipe: a section heading resolves to the pane-title size, a subsection heading to the body size, and both carry zero margins, so no section can regress to the user-agent heading scale.

mutation.declaration: styles/surface.module.css: .settingsSectionHeadingPaneTitle { font-size: var(--font-size-pane-title) } changed to var(--font-size-body), and separately .settingsSectionHeading { margin: 0 } deleted
mutation.note: The pane-title mutation failed with 'section heading font-size is 15px, expected the pane-title probe 20px'; deleting the margin reset failed with 'section heading margins are 16.6px/16.6px, expected 0/0; subsection heading margins are 15px/15px, expected 0/0'. Both were reverted and the case passed again.
